enrichment.core_claim: Spectroscopy of Bennu asteroid nanoglobules shows multiscale coherent emissions, possibly polyatomic time crystals where Penrose OR proto-consciousness sparked life.
enrichment.ask_question: What follow-up measurement could identify the emitting structures in the nanoglobules?
enrichment.challenge_question: Could ordinary fluorescence of layered organics explain the emission bands without time crystals or proto-consciousness?
